$comment: Server time is UTC across all states. The four rotating events below are taken from the official August 2026 in-game calendar and are on a 28-day cycle, each starting Monday 00:00 and running seven days to the end of the following Sunday. The alliance-run events further down are NOT state-wide — each alliance's R4/R5 triggers those, so their days and times are placeholders you should replace. The in-game Events calendar is always authoritative.

rotation.note: Anchored to the August 2026 calendar. Century Games shifts the order occasionally, so re-check against an in-game month view if the app starts disagreeing with the game.

events.name: Alliance Mobilization
events.notes: Week 1 of 4. Take tasks you can actually finish — a task you abandon is one the alliance does not score.

events.name: State of Power
events.notes: Week 2 of 4. This is the week the day-by-day scoring themes on the VS Duel page apply to — bank speedups, gear and hero material in the three weeks leading up to it.

events.name: Alliance Showdown
events.notes: Week 3 of 4. Alliance versus alliance — follow your R4/R5's calls rather than acting solo.

events.name: Bear Trap
events.notes: PLACEHOLDER — set by your own R4/R5, not by the state. It runs on a ~47.5h cooldown after each hunt, so the alliance picks when to trigger it. Two fixed days a week is how most alliances run it in practice. The hunt itself lasts 30 minutes.

events.name: Crazy Joe
events.notes: PLACEHOLDER — confirm the day and time in game. Keep troops in the city and a shield ready for the final wave.

events.name: Foundry Battle
events.notes: PLACEHOLDER — alternates fortnightly with Frostfire Mine, and which half of the cycle your state is in shows only in game. Rally leads should be online 15 minutes early.

events.name: Frostfire Mine
events.notes: PLACEHOLDER, off by default — alternates fortnightly with Foundry Battle. Switch this on and Foundry off in the weeks it runs, or set both to a 14-day cycle once you know which week your state is on.

events.name: Frostdragon Tyrant
events.notes: PLACEHOLDER — confirm with your alliance. Bring your best marksman heroes.

events.name: Canyon Clash
events.notes: PLACEHOLDER, off by default — only the top alliances in the state by power qualify, so switch it on if yours does.

events.name: Daily reset
events.notes: Daily missions, free chest, hero recruitment and alliance help all roll over at 00:00 UTC. Off by default — switch it on if you want the countdown.
